sections.title: Genetics, painted by hand.
sections.lede: One breeder. Every cross selected, grown and documented like a work in progress.

sections.heading: One breeder. Every plant a canvas.
sections.body:
Genetic Artistry is a one-person cannabis genetics company. Every cross is selected, grown and documented by hand, treating each plant like a work of art in progress.

Follow along for new drops, grow notes and the story behind each line.
sections.plate_caption: Each line is judged leaf by leaf: structure first, then aroma, then vigour.
sections.quote: Most genetics are made to be common. Ours are made to be remembered. Each line begins as a quiet idea, a colour, a scent, a mood, and is painted into being over many seasons by one pair of hands.

sections.heading: From sketch to seed
sections.intro: Calm, careful and in the open. Four steps from first idea to finished line.

steps.title: Select
steps.text: Hundreds of seedlings are grown out and judged on structure, aroma and vigour. Only a handful earn a second look.

steps.title: Cross
steps.text: Chosen parents are paired with intent. Every pairing is recorded, from the first pollen to the last seed.

steps.title: Cultivate
steps.text: Plants are grown by hand under steady conditions, so what we see in a line is genuinely the genetics speaking.

steps.title: Document
steps.text: Each season is photographed, measured and written up, so every line has a story and a trail of evidence.

sections.heading: The collection
sections.intro: Five lines, each bred slowly and released in limited seed runs.
